Bird & Vine Plates

Watercolour cards in the manner of a painted greeting card. The birds are real 18th-century watercolours from the Rijksmuseum, cut from their paper; the creeper around them grows itself, branch by branch, and its stems never cross.

The bird library

Every bird is a public-domain watercolour from the Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam. Each was cut from its paper and stray perch fragments were masked. Tap a bird to paint it.
